# Phobos Auto Nav: equipment and item reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-item-reference.ps1. Edit config/item-reference.json, not this file. -->

Current source candidate: **0.14.0**. Game target: **1.0.1.5**. Values below come from offline definitions; they do not establish installation, gameplay validation or a live merchant quote.

Asterel plug-in boards for the native Polaris navigation station. Fit them into the station’s module slots and use the shared Phobos flight hub; they are not floor fixtures and have no INSTALL tile. Working N1/N2 provide navigation, while N3 supplies independent fire controls. Removing a module can suspend the function that owns it.

**Reading prices:** credits per complete object at the stated condition, before shop margins, market effects, negotiation and extra wear. Pristine retail can cost more. Mass is the empty/dry definition or fresh commodity template; saved contents and variable recovery packets can weigh differently. Dismantle value is the sum of all listed outputs at base value, excluding labour and tools.

**Repair and Restore:** Repair fixes a damaged form and retains the actual consumed service materials as spent parts. Restore reduces wear on functional equipment in place; it does not grant pristine status. Empty cargo and follow the machine’s local maintenance guards first. Work speed depends on crew, tools and current condition.

**Finding stock:** the generated percentages are defaults per eligible native stock/loot roll, not per ship or guaranteed shop availability. Offers are additive, may be independent, and require normal restocking. Loot branches choose at most one added item per branch. Configuration, capacity and native generation rules still apply; loading an existing save does not refill its inventories.

<a id="n1"></a>

## N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module

Navigation, approach and docking assistance. It can stop short of a destination or use a separate docking command.

**Use:** Fit a working board to Polaris, open its Phobos hub, select a supported sensor contact, set arrival preferences and choose Fly, Dock or Approach & Dock as appropriate. Use Stop to release flight control.

**Where it appears:** Build at a supported table, buy from the listed dealers, or find rare N1 boards in native navigation-module loot. Damaged salvage needs repair.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

No obstacle avoidance or indefinite position holding is promised. Sensor quality, braking room, fuel and native restrictions still apply. Docking resumes only after an explicit post-load Resume.

Full operating instructions: [N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module guide](auto-navigate-adaptation.md).

<a id="n2"></a>

## N2 Polaris Pursuit Module

Includes navigation/docking and adds Rendezvous and Follow for moving contacts.

**Use:** Fit to Polaris and use the Pursuit page. Rendezvous approaches once; Follow maintains a distance band. Stop before changing flight modes.

**Where it appears:** Build at a supported table or buy the Polaris dealer offer below. The N1 salvage pool does not grant N2.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

N2 does not authorize firing; use N3 for that. Pursuit suspends on reload and cannot guarantee catching a faster ship.

Full operating instructions: [N2 Polaris Pursuit Module guide](auto-nav-pursuit.md).

<a id="n3"></a>

## N3 Polaris Fire Control System

Independent weapon observations, bounded offensive volleys and optional RCS aiming. It can operate without N1/N2.

**Use:** Fit to Polaris, open Fire, choose the target and weapon group, then explicitly grant Engage. Cease Fire keeps offensive hold; Return to Native releases that hold.

**Where it appears:** Build at a supported table or buy the Polaris dealer offer below. No separate N3 derelict-loot addition is registered.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

Firing permission is not restored from a save. N2 plus N3 combines Follow and firing; flight braking and clearance take priority over aiming.

Full operating instructions: [N3 Polaris Fire Control System guide](auto-nav-fire-control.md).

<a id="offcuts"></a>

## Electronics assembly offcuts

Retained material left over when any N1/N2/N3 board is constructed.

**Use:** Keep, haul or offer to a compatible scrap buyer.

**Where it appears:** Appears beside the new board at construction completion.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

The name still mentions N1, but all three board recipes share this identity. It is not a small electronic-parts item and has no current refining recipe.

Full operating instructions: [Electronics assembly offcuts guide](auto-nav-economy.md).

<a id="board-residue"></a>

## Board residue

Terminal remainder from dismantling any working or damaged N1/N2/N3 board.

**Use:** Treat as retained scrap cargo; reuse or repair a board before choosing irreversible dismantling.

**Where it appears:** Produced by the Dismantle action on a board.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

The N1-labelled identity is shared across all three models. It cannot be refined into electronics by a current Phobos recipe.

Full operating instructions: [Board residue guide](auto-nav-economy.md).
